name: Role Claimant Fixture
description: Phase 7.1.1 fixture. Declares and provides the `memory.recall` service role, returning archived scene ids in reverse index order so its answer is trivially distinguishable from core's relevance ranking. Deliberately NOT shipped in `mods/`: that directory is the installed set, it is loaded live by the running app, and enablement is absent-means-enabled — a role claimant there would replace real users' memory recall on next load.
author: Narrative Engine
